Omar: quick heads-up — small UX/a11y catch in the prompt-set diffs. On small viewports the action strip we discussed disappears from keyboard tab order when it becomes sticky. Repro steps in e2e attached: /e2e/prompt-evals/strip-focus-issue.spec.js Maria: saw that in UX review. I think we should keep the strip in DOM order after the list so tab order is predictable. We can visually pin it with CSS but DOM order must match logical flow. Also want microcopy for the strip: 'Approve visible' + 'Re-run visible' — explicit verbs. Jen: agreed. Implementation plan: render
after the list container, absolutely position it to bottom:0. Add aria-live="polite" to announce when it appears: 'Actions available: Approve visible results, Re-run'. I'll prototype and post PR. Sam: a11y checklist: 1) action-strip should have role="region" and aria-label="Eval actions"; 2) when it appears, do not move focus; instead announce via aria-live; 3) buttons must have aria-labels with context e.g. 'Approve 8 visible results'. Example snippet: ```
``` Luca: analytics: capture event action_strip_shown with properties {visible_count, viewport_width, breakpoint}. Also capture approve_from_strip true/false. We want to know discovery and usage. QA Bot: automated-check: visual contrast OK, keyboard-e2e failing in headless Chrome: focus order jumps to top toolbar when strip injected mid-scroll. Failing test: /e2e/prompt-evals/strip-focus-issue.spec.js line 42. Maria: two design decisions: 1) show strip only after the user scrolls past X px; 2) allow keyboard users to reveal same controls with a persistent 'Actions' affordance at top as well. That gives parity for mouse and keyboard. Thoughts? Jen: I prefer single source of truth — don't duplicate controls. If keyboard users can't reach the strip, we should add a skip-link at the top: 'Skip to actions (Shift+A)'. It's keyboard discoverable and doesn't clutter UI. Add hint text in toolbar: 'Press Shift+A to open actions'. Sam: if adding a shortcut, ensure it is optional and documented. For screen reader users provide a help dialog listing shortcuts. Also ensure Shift+A doesn't conflict with browser shortcuts. We should opt for `Shift+.` or configurable. Karen: microcopy nit: 'Approve visible' could be ambiguous. Suggest 'Approve visible results' and in the confirm modal show exact count: 'Approve 8 visible results? This will mark selected items as expected for this run.' Include 'View changes' link. Luca: analytics: include property approved_scope: 'visible'|'all' and approved_count in confirm event. Also log shortcut_used boolean. QA Bot: e2e suggestion: when strip appears mid-scroll, ensure it is appended to DOM after list container. Tests should assert document order: listContainer.nextElementSibling.id === 'action-strip'. Current impl fails this on Safari. Jen: I'll update prototype to keep DOM order and add tabindex management: when user presses Shift+A we focus first button in the strip. If strip not present we reveal it (same DOM location) and focus. Adding aria-hidden when not shown so SRs don't prematurely see it. Sam: caution: toggling aria-hidden can cause reflow for assistive tech. Prefer to keep it in DOM with off-screen positioning and aria-hidden="true" until visible. When making visible remove aria-hidden and set focus appropriately. Announce via aria-live that 'Actions are now available'. Omar: timeline: Jen to open PR with prototype and examples of aria attributes, Sam to add accessibility notes in the PR description, Luca to provide analytics event schema, QA to add a targeted e2e asserting DOM order and tab sequence. Sync Thurs 10am to validate. Maria: one more small UX ask — add a low-contrast divider above the strip so it reads as separate area. Also include a subtle shadow to indicate overlay. I'll update Figma and add token suggestions. Karen: final copy approval: 'Approve 8 visible results' for CTA, confirm modal title 'Approve visible results?', body 'Approving will mark these results as expected for this prompt set. You can revert this from regression history.' primary CTA 'Approve 8 results' secondary 'View changes' cancel 'Cancel'. Jen: noted. I'll include all copy strings as i18n keys in the PR so localization can review. ETA PR EOD Wednesday. Omar: thanks everyone. tagging: @Jen @Sam @Luca @QA Bot — please update respective tasks. We'll verify with accessibility QA before merging. :thumbsup:
